gen-gf-alumni-sans-collegiate-one-fs-kar: Alumni Sans Collegiate One stacks its glyphs tightly, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals. And Karma, a classic serif, keeps that tall-lowercase look but softens it with gentle, trustworthy strokes.
gen-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe-fs-erode: Hollow, glass-tube lettering with a single constant line leads the way. Erode, a serif with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, gives the pair its warmth and editorial dignity.
gen-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe-fs-karma: Karma moves smoothly, its swing from thick to thin never snagging. Beside it, Alumni Sans Pinstripe feels like following one hollow thread, so the whole pairing reads in a mellow, unhurried way.
gen-gf-alumni-sans-sc-fs-erode: Capitals that stand barely taller than the lowercase give Alumni Sans SC a distinctive, compact look up top. Erode, a serif, picks up that tall middle band and adds dignity.
gen-gf-alumni-sans-sc-fs-karma: Alumni Sans SC keeps its capitals close to lowercase height. Karma, a classic serif, shares that tight height range, so the two feel like relatives with different manners.
gen-gf-amiko-fs-erode: Erode reads with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow in its strokes. Make Amiko small and its chunky, open-mouthed forms lose some punch beside that serif, so give it room to be bold.
gen-gf-amiko-fs-karma: Karma is a serif with terminals that finish well clear of the stem and a calm, moderate modulation. Under Amiko's chunky, tall midzone, it reads smoothly and without a single snag.
gen-gf-anaheim-fs-erode: Clean, tight-set letters give Anaheim a clamped, vise-grip look with rounds left unsealed. Erode, a serif with gentle stroke variation, loosens the mood, and it holds up nicely if the body text goes a bit larger.
gen-gf-anaheim-fs-karma: Rounds left unlatched, like an open hook, mark Anaheim as the more unusual voice here. Karma, a serif with a soft, understated change in thickness, gives the page a steadier, more traditional footing.
